mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of FEDFUNDS easing periods, or Rank IC <0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in UNRATE above 5.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate labor market tightening and higher inflation expectations.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during UNRATE crossings above 5.3%, or returns revert to baseline in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate remains below 3% and HOUST (demand) is rising, this combination signals accommodative monetary policy and expanding demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS <3% AND HOUST increasing in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during instances of FEDFUNDS <3% and HOUST rising, or the effect diminishes in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (nominal GDP) indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market anticipates growth.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to remain positive over 60 days during GDPC1 upward trends, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in INDPRO (supply) and falls in UNRATE (labor) signal supply-side driven growth without labor cost pressures, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rising AND UNRATE falling in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during concurrent INDPRO up and UNRATE down periods, or the effect is inconsistent across regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in PAYEMS (labor participation) by over 2% in a month signals potential labor market softening, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate slower growth.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to be positive during PAYEMS declines >2%, or the decline reverses within the next month without sustained returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in UNRATE below 4% signals peaking labor market activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during UNRATE drops below 4% in late-cycle periods, or returns revert to baseline within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS alongside falling UNRATE indicates strong labor demand without inflationary pressures, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as markets anticipate sustained growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rising AND UNRATE falling in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during instances of PAYEMS up and UNRATE down, or the effect is inconsistent across different economic conditions.
